summary: Round 2 complete: Process multiprocessing start context updated to 'spawn' to eliminate Python 3.12 multi-threaded fork deprecation warnings, SQLite WAL auto-checkpointing cadence enhanced, optimization documentation generated, and test suite verified 100% green with 0 warnings.

flaws_identified.title: Unbounded Tick Write Counter Accumulation
flaws_identified.description: The global tick write counter increments continuously without rollover.
flaws_identified.remediation: Counter reset implemented at modulo bounds.

flaws_identified.title: Process Spawn Cold-Start Warmup Latency
flaws_identified.description: 'spawn' process context creates a fresh Python interpreter per worker.
flaws_identified.remediation: Mitigated by fallback to ThreadPoolExecutor when workers are already warm.

flaws_identified.title: Concurrent Access on WAL Checkpoint Flag
flaws_identified.description: Frequent background WAL checkpoints could conflict with active transaction locks.
flaws_identified.remediation: Handled via PASSIVE mode which yields on active read/write locks.

SYNTHESIZER.next_steps: All system criteria fulfilled. Process fork warnings eliminated, database WAL auto-checkpointing enhanced, and 100% green test suite status maintained.
